note: Written from the spec (§2d) only, not from a live page: a US 'Do not sell or share' notice with Close and policy links. Phase 1 leaves these alone; the gate must say no, or the chooser could click its Close. Deliberately has no cookie toggles, unlike tidio-cookiebot (a positive whose opt-out toggle is part of a consent panel).

banner.text: Your privacy choices We and our partners use cookies and similar technologies to personalize content and ads. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information.
